conventions.convention: Relative entropy is directional D(P || Q), uses natural logarithms and 0 log 0 = 0, and is infinite without absolute continuity. Total variation is sup_A |P(A)-Q(A)|, giving Pinsker's bound sqrt(D/2).

Positions are dimensionless numerical coordinates x = q_phys/ell_0; momentum marks have SI momentum units. The potential and total energy are numerical in units E_0, K(p)=|p|²/(2mE_0), and b=E_0/(k_B T).

The phase reference retains the unit-intensity Poisson sector factor e^(-V)/N! and uses r(dp)=dp/p_*^d. Integrating marks multiplies the positional partition by kappa_b^N and changes full activity z_ph to positional activity z_ph kappa_b.
Periodic continuation copies each point's momentum mark unchanged to every spatial translate x+Lk. Local observations use the restriction of this continuation to a fixed bounded Borel spatial region.

The shell is normalized phase-reference restriction to a specifically constructed shrinking energy-density band whose canonical probability tends to one. It is neither an exact energy surface nor an assertion about arbitrary prescribed widths.

The positional transfer uses integer side lengths, an interior positive attainable density, a finite supporting activity, a singleton grand variational minimizer, and AC, ultrafilter extension, DC and HB. Its infinite-volume state is a variational minimizer; no DLR identification or finite-volume grand convergence is asserted.
Canonical, band and grand distributions are adopted alternative preparations, with a_0=ell_0 p_*. They supply no empirical observations or dynamical equilibration claim.

load_bearing.statement: Under its choice, interaction, integer-period, interior-density, supporting-activity and singleton-minimizer hypotheses, the shell positional empirical-field barycenter converges to P_* in the local-tame topology; shell and exact-N canonical expectations converge to P_*(f) for every local-tame f, and P_* has intensity rho.
Defines the superstable regular marked model, phase reference, physical units and periodic Hamiltonian; canonical marks factor as independent nu_b marks, and Z_ph=kappa_b^N Z_pos.

Under its choice, model, interior-density, nearby partition-rate and differentiability hypotheses, total energy density concentrates exponentially around -partial_b F_b(rho)+d rho/(2b); a nonincreasing delta_n tending to zero can be chosen so the associated band has canonical probability tending to one and positive finite phase-reference measure eventually.
For the constructed band, D(M_n^ph || C_n^ph)/V_n tends to zero; no convergence of the unscaled divergence or global total variation is asserted.

For a fixed bounded Borel region Delta contained in a cube C, the expected shell conditional mark divergence relative to the Gaussian product on its randomly occupied points is at most D(M_n^ph || C_n^ph)/floor(L_n/ell)^d and therefore tends to zero.

Assuming AC, relative entropy of a finite joint law against a product probability reference is at least the sum of its marginal divergences. Finite joint entropy admits the stated conditional chain equality; zero-occupancy blocks contribute zero.

The Gaussian mark reference has normalization kappa_b=(2 pi m E_0/(b p_*²))^(d/2), means E p_i=0, E p_i p_j=(m E_0/b)delta_ij and E K=d/(2b); each named observable has a centered log moment-generating function finite and C² near zero with value and derivative zero there.

Under the positional-minimizer hypotheses, shell and exact-N canonical expectations of every fixed bounded measurable marked-local observable converge to the independent Gaussian-marked lift of P_*; shell convergence also holds when |G|≤C(1+N_Delta).

For a fixed bounded half-open cube, shell local kinetic-energy, first-momentum and second-momentum sum expectations tend respectively to d rho |Delta|/(2b), zero, and (m E_0 rho |Delta|/b)delta_ij; canonical and marked variational laws have the same limits.
